sentences.text: This {stage} {sex} spotted seal was tracked from {first_date} to {last_date}, a span of {days_tracked}.
Spotted seals live in the North Pacific and Arctic seas and use the edge of the sea ice in spring to give birth.
On {farthest_date} she was {max_displacement_km} from where her track began: {species_rank_distance}.
Most of her record is a single silence of {longest_gap_days}.
Why the tag went quiet isn't recorded. The map shows the gap as a dashed line, not a guessed route.
